evidence.quote: Where a is the acceleration, m is the mass of the aircraft, and F is the net force acting on the aircraft.
The net force is the difference between the opposing forces; lift minus weight, or thrust minus drag.
If the forces become unbalanced, the aircraft will move in the direction of the greater force.

objectives: Compute acceleration from net force and mass using F = m * a
Predict whether an aircraft rises, falls, accelerates, or slows from unbalanced lift, weight, thrust, and drag
